full_prompt_en: A square ornamental illustration shows a young woman in right-facing profile beside a peacock. Her pale face is calm, with closed eyes, a softly shaded cheek and a small coral mouth. Gold and copper hair is gathered into a heavy coiled bun at the back of the head. A fan of long orange and red segments radiates behind it like a decorative headdress. A tiny gold pendant earring hangs below the ear. At the lower left, her garment is covered in overlapping scale-like leaves that shift from bright gold near the shoulder to deep burgundy at the bottom. Immediately behind and to the right, a peacock fills a large circular teal field. Its blue head and neck rise toward the woman, while the orange breast and small crest add warm echoes. Several large eye spots appear in the dark teal plumage near the upper right and lower edges. Fine feather lines, curls and mosaic-like repeats cover the circle. The surrounding rectangular ground is dense brick red with faint geometric and floral patterns, framed by a narrow dark border. The skin is smoother than the surrounding decorative textures, making the face the quiet center of the image. Warm gold and crimson areas press against saturated turquoise and blue-green, with almost no unworked space. Light is even and emblematic rather than naturalistic, while small highlights on the cheek and gold details provide restrained brightness. Thin dark contours keep the densely patterned surfaces legible. The composition locks the profile, radiating fan and curving peacock together in a close, flattened arrangement. The whole panel has the rhythm of an illuminated decorative print, balancing still human expression with intricate repeated motifs.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰插画呈现一位年轻女子向右的侧影，旁边是一只孔雀。她的浅色面孔平静，双眼闭合，脸颊有柔和阴影，嘴唇带珊瑚色。金铜色头发在脑后盘成厚重发髻。一扇橙红长条在发髻后放射，像装饰头饰。耳下垂着小金坠耳环。左下方，她的衣裳布满重叠的鳞片状叶形，从肩附近的亮金色渐变为底部深酒红。紧靠她后方与右侧，孔雀填满一块大的圆形青绿色域。蓝色头颈向女子升起，橙色胸部和小冠羽呼应暖色。几只大眼状纹出现在右上与下缘附近的深青绿羽毛中。细羽线、卷纹和近似马赛克的重复图形覆盖圆形区域。周围长方形底色是密集砖红，隐约有几何与花草纹，并被狭窄深色边框圈住。女子皮肤比周围装饰肌理更平滑，使面孔成为安静中心。暖金与深红色域压向饱和青绿和蓝绿，几乎没有未加工的空白。光均匀且带徽章感，而非自然写实，脸颊和金色细节上的小亮点提供克制的明度。细暗轮廓让密集纹饰仍可辨认。构图把侧影、放射扇形和弯曲的孔雀锁在紧凑、扁平的布局中。整块画板具有彩饰版画般的节奏，以静止的人物神情平衡繁复重复的图案。
style_prompt_en: The image has a richly worked ornamental illustration surface with precise dark outlines, fine internal hatching and mosaic-like repeated marks. Saturated copper red and gold occupy broad warm areas, set against deep teal, turquoise and blue-green. Circular and radiating structures interlock with a rectangular patterned field, creating dense rhythm without a conventional deep setting. One smooth, pale passage provides a quiet resting point amid textured color. Edges are sharply defined around large shapes, while tiny repeated marks enliven their interiors. Gradations remain modest; light is mostly even and carried by value contrast and small gold highlights. Scale-like layering, curling linework and eye-shaped motifs produce a tactile, printed quality. The composition is close and flattened, with nearly every part of the frame actively patterned. Warm and cool colors repeat across separate areas so the arrangement feels woven together. The overall effect is luminous and decorative, driven by intricate surface design rather than realistic volume or perspective.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有加工繁密的装饰插画表面，暗轮廓准确，内部排线细密，并有近似马赛克的重复笔痕。饱和铜红和金色形成宽阔暖区，与深青绿、绿松石色和蓝绿色对置。圆形与放射结构同长方形纹样色域交错，营造密集节奏，却不建立常规深远场景。一段平滑浅色区域在有肌理的颜色间提供安静停顿。大形体周围边缘锋利，其内部由细小重复笔痕激活。渐变保持克制；光主要均匀，由明度对照和少量金色亮点承载。鳞片状层叠、卷曲线条和眼形纹样制造可触的印刷质感。构图紧凑、扁平，几乎整幅画面都由活跃纹饰占据。冷暖色在不同区域反复出现，让布局像编织在一起。整体效果发亮且装饰性强，由繁复表面设计驱动，而非写实体积或透视。
theme_en: A golden-haired woman in profile stands beside a peacock within a red and turquoise ornamental panel
theme_zh: 一位金发女子的侧影与孔雀并立于红色和青绿装饰画板中
name: Emily Balivet
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
